qa_pair.question: The cc-inspect server exposes four tools. Name them, sorted alphabetically and separated by comma and space.
Use code with action "modules" and version "2.1.312". How many modules does that install hold?
Use code with action "search", query "CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT", module "chunk-017gw5jn.js", context 0, limit 1, and version "2.1.312". At which offset is the hit?
Use code with action "read", module "chunk-017gw5jn.js", offset 33863, length 40, and version "2.1.312". Which minified name does CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT map to?
Use surface with kind "env" (the key is kind, not action), name "CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE", and version "2.1.312". How many env variables match?
Use surface with kind "setting" (singular, not "settings"), name "autoMode", and version "2.1.312". How many settings match?
Use surface with kind "mod-api", name "prompt.fill", and version "2.1.312". How many items match?
Use surface with kind "hook-event" and version "2.1.312". How many hook events does it list?
Use surface with no kind (surface has no list action or argument) and version "2.1.312" to list the kinds with their counts. How many env items are there?
Use sessions with action "tool-calls" and session "inspect/mcp/test/fixtures/sessions/docs-lookup.jsonl" from the repository root. How many read_page calls does it hold?
Use sessions with action "tool-calls", session "inspect/mcp/test/fixtures/sessions/docs-lookup.jsonl", and query "search_docs". How many calls match?
Use sessions with action "search", session "inspect/mcp/test/fixtures/sessions/docs-lookup.jsonl", and query "Budgets". On which line is the match?
Use sessions with action "read", session "inspect/mcp/test/fixtures/sessions/docs-lookup.jsonl", type "assistant", offset 1, and limit 1. Which route does the line read?
Use sessions with action "validate" and session "inspect/mcp/test/fixtures/sessions/docs-lookup.jsonl". How many lines fail the transcript schema?
Use release with action "diff", from "2.1.311", to "2.1.312", and limit 1. How many functions changed?
Use release with action "explain", name "CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE", and version "2.1.312". In which module and at which offset does the name live?
